name: Vital Spark · Death ×2
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 1.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 1 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
• Growth: up to 2 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Withering: −0.75 ❤ per second for 5 s
• Life drain: 1.25 ❤ damage, you heal 0.5 ❤
self_description:
